_comment: sunset - warm amber icons against the theme's brown-black worksheet.
Same `tint` mechanism as midnight, different hue: sunset's grid lines are
a warm 0.317/0.189/0.15, so the icons take the complementary warm accent
rather than midnight's cool one. See that recipe for why `tint` preserves
This theme flattens several operator-type colours to black (SOP, SOP.hilite,
SOP.editbg are all 0/0/0), so the eye has less colour to navigate by. The
semantic groups are therefore painted *more* strongly here than in
midnight rather than less: the error and viewer badges are doing more
work in this theme, not less.
